title: Grand Theft Auto: Sindacco Chronicles
description: GTA Sindacco Chronicles is a total conversion mod from the authors and developers of Forelli Redemption (a mod for GTA 3) for Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories that came out in 2005. 1998. A new Mafia war is on the rise in Liberty City — the Sindacco, Forelli and Leone families are at their throats again for domination over the worst city in America. The Sindaccos, led by the ambitious Paulie Sindacco, plan to conquer what they can before the others can get their hands on what’s left of the city. A loyal henchman they have, Joseph Daniel O’Toole, is supposed to infiltrate the Leone Family. Meanwhile, Paulie’s two nephews, Frank and Marcus, are preparing their men for a big war…

title: Mortal Kombat – Unchained
description: Mortal Kombat: Unchained is the portable version of the game Mortal Kombat: Deception, initially released on consoles. It includes all of the characters from the GameCube version and four additional ones unique to the PSP version. These four characters are Blaze, Frost, Jax, and Kitana. An ancient foe has resurfaced in this episode of the 3D beat-em-up series that has returned. The protagonists engage in combat with one another to win the right to take on and defeat this threat and become the Champion of the Elder Gods. Every character can access various moves, including fatalities, weaponry, etc. The arenas feature multiple levels, different types of player interaction, and deadly hazards. You can play a free-roaming adventure in the Konquest Mode, fight an endless wave of opponents in the Endurance Mode (which is exclusive to the PSP), go head-to-head over Wi-Fi against another human player, or try a mini-game such as Chess Kombat (which is chess with the MK characters) or Puzzle Kombat (which is Tetris with a twist). All of these modes are available in addition to the regular battles.

title: Blur
description: Blur is an action racing game similar to Mario Kart. The special point of this version is the licensed sports cars instead of go-carts. Therefore, players race on fantasy and real-world tracks to change their feelings. Power-ups and weapons are scattered around the tracks. Cars have unique statistics, making vehicle choices tactical. Therefore, winning comes from the careful strategy of players. The game includes various race types and events across 14 locations, including a boss fight. Winning events earn lights, which unlock new content like Fan Runs, which are mini-challenges during races. In this game, you have the fans and should please them to progress. Players can do this by destroying cars or performing impressive driving skills. The game totally combines realistic cars with fantastical elements, creating a unique racing experience.

title: The Last of Us
description: Players control Joel from a third-person view with the playable Ellie later. The gameplay mixes action, exploration, and puzzles. Joel is not as agile as in Uncharted games because he often needs tools to climb. The game has a survival horror theme with limited resources. Stealth is often more effective than direct combat with five infected enemies and human groups. Therefore, players can use various weapons with scarce ammo, and a few use melee. Stealth allows for sneaking and special takedowns. Joel can use a hearing sense to detect enemies. Quick-time events appear during attacks. Joel can sprint, use a flashlight, and swim. He can throw objects to distract or stun enemies. The cover is automatic and based on line of sight. The game emphasizes sound and visibility for stealth mechanics.

title: PES 2013 - Pro Evolution Soccer
description: Pro Evolution Soccer 2013” is a game about soccer sport produced and developed by Konami. The game launched in 2012 when the football sport had a great influence on the world. Along with that, the birth of the team has become a symbol of the future with the legendary players going into people’s hearts. The game has changed some features compared to the previous version, “Pro Evolution Soccer 2012” when the game is now more like a soccer match than an arcade action like the previous version. This makes the game similar to “FIFA 12”, but that doesn’t matter much. Along with that, players get a new game control system, called “PES FullControl”, which brings the first new dynamic touch feature, where players can trap the ball using the R2 button to gain control of the ball immediately. This new feature combined with the “person-by-person” feature that was introduced to controllers in previous versions increased the ability to control the ball and surpass the opponent. This new experience will certainly be satisfied for long-time PES fans, but it will not cause any difficulties for first-time players.

title: Mortal Kombat
description: New Mortal Kombat starts from the beginning of the series and the plot. Starting with the first three games, it goes back to the original tournaments. Chapters in the game’s Story mode are based on different characters. Throughout matches, players take on several responsibilities. Through many types of wars, fights help players discover the plot where various choices appear along with playable characters. Simultaneously, arcade modes help players find nostalgia for the older games, besides the Story mode. A new Challenge Tower has been added to the mini-games when 300 tasks await players when they reach the top of this tower. Obstacles might be anything from evading attacks to slaying zombies. In addition, some tasks require you to assume a particular role, such as protecting a movie set while playing Johnny Cage.

title: PES 2018: Pro Evolution Soccer
description: As a fiercely contending counterpart to FIFA, Pro Evolution Soccer, brought to life by the creators of the acclaimed Castlevania and Metal Gear Solid, Konami, has continuously gripped the heartstrings and wallets of soccer enthusiasts worldwide. The 2018 installation of the Pro Evolution Soccer series, tailored explicitly for PS3, brings an ensemble of diverse soccer teams, despite the observable absence of specific licenses held by Electronic Arts. This variant continues to indulge players with single and multiplayer gaming modes and training programs designed to hone their soccer skills.
